description: Design Envelope 4300 and 4380 vertical in-line pumps with IVS drive, Modbus register map version 2 (firmware 1.17 and newer): speed, power, voltage, current, sensorless head and flow, I/O, units, counters, control mode, HOA, setpoints, alarms and warnings
source: Armstrong, Design Envelope 4300 & 4380 Vertical In-line pumping unit with IVS drive, Installation & Operating Instructions 101.82, section 3.3

sources.title: Design Envelope 4300 & 4380 Vertical In-line pumping unit with IVS drive, Installation and Operating Instructions
sources.note: section 3.3, Modbus register map version 2 (firmware v1.17 and newer); section 7 alarm and warning tables

notes: Modbus RTU or Modbus TCP; address, baud rate, parity and stop bits are set on the pump control module.
Addresses are the start addresses of the manual (the column next to them is the Modbus register number, one higher). Read with function 03, write with 06.
Firmware v1.16 and older use a different register map (version 1, section 3.1 of the manual), not in this map.
The manual does not give the word order of 32-bit values; this map assumes the high word first.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
